bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = 600 || exit 71
old_inode=$(stat -c %i "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")
git -C "$r/.worktrees/userbot-room-public-cb3e13c" show cb3e13c2156f5f8b04645adb121057e88d1c2b4a:scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py | cmp -s - "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py" || exit 72
"$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 73
git -C "$r" fetch -q origin fix/room-public-smoke-phase-diagnostics-20261113
test "$(git -C "$r" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = fb6678b24dfad4f0f204699ddbf5109c729fe3aa || exit 74
tmp=$(mktemp "$r/scripts/.room_public_smoke.XXXXXX")
git -C "$r" show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py > "$tmp"
chmod 644 "$tmp"
python3 -B - "$tmp" <<'PY'
import ast,sys,pathlib
ast.parse(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding='utf8'))
PY
backup=$(mktemp "$r/scripts/.room_public_smoke_backup.XXXXXX")
cp -p "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py" "$backup"
mv "$tmp" "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py"
if ! systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service; then cp -p "$backup" "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py"; systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || :; echo ROOM_SMOKE_ACTIVATION_ROLLBACK; exit 75; fi
ready=no
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active && "$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=yes; break; fi
 sleep 1
done
if test "$ready" != yes; then cp -p "$backup" "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py"; systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || :; echo ROOM_SMOKE_ACTIVATION_ROLLBACK; exit 76; fi
test "$(stat -c %i "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = "$old_inode" || exit 77
test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = 600 || exit 78
echo USERBOT_PUBLIC_ROOM_PHASE_DIAGNOSTICS_ACTIVE=PASS
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_AUTH_AND_SESSION_PRESERVED=PASS
